Your Mii avatar shown in your presence (optional)
Works with a custom firmware (CFW): boot.firm + config file on your SD card

consent.title: Welcome to 3DS Presence!
consent.description: Before creating your account, please review the following documents:
consent.checkbox: I have read and accept the Privacy Policy and the Terms of Service

sections.title: 1. Data Controller
lines: 3DS Presence project — Contact: privacy@3ds-presence.top
This project is open source (AGPL-3.0). If you are using an instance hosted by a third party, please refer to that instance's own privacy policy.

sections.title: 2. Data Collected
lines: The following personal data is collected when you create an account:
list: Discord user ID (snowflake) — used to link your Discord profile
Unique account identifier (UUID) — used to identify your session
AES-256 encryption key — used to encrypt communication between your 3DS and the server
Discord OAuth2 tokens (access and refresh tokens) — used to update your Discord Rich Presence
Game title, publisher, and title ID — the game you are currently playing on your 3DS
Mii avatar data (optional, if enabled) — used to display your Mii as a small image in your Discord presence
IP address — temporarily stored in server access logs for security and rate-limiting purposes

sections.title: 3. Purpose
lines: The sole purpose of data processing is to provide Discord Rich Presence for Nintendo 3DS: displaying your current game on your Discord profile.

sections.title: 4. Legal Basis
lines: Your explicit consent. By checking the consent box during account creation, you agree to this privacy policy.

sections.title: 5. Data Recipients
lines: Discord Inc. — your data is shared with Discord via their API (OAuth2 and Rich Presence) to display your game status on your Discord profile.
No other third parties have access to your data.

sections.title: 6. Data Retention
list: Account data (discord_id, UUID, AES key, tokens): deleted after 3 years of inactivity
IP logs (server access logs): 3 months maximum
You can delete your account at any time: instant deletion from the database

sections.title: 7. Your Rights
lines: Under the GDPR, you have the following rights:
list: Right of access — export your data via the dashboard (JSON format)
Right to rectification — contact us to correct inaccurate data
Right to erasure — delete your account at any time via the dashboard
Right to withdraw consent — delete your account to withdraw consent
Right to data portability — export your data in a machine-readable format (JSON)
Right to object — you may object to the processing of your data by deleting your account

sections.title: 8. Security
lines: AES-256 encryption for client-server communication
HTTPS for all web connections
The source code is open (AGPL-3.0) and auditable

sections.title: 9. Anti-Bot Protection
lines: Cloudflare Turnstile is used as an anti-bot protection during sign-in.
https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/

sections.title: 10. Hosting
lines: This service is self-hosted on a personal server located in France.

sections.title: 11. Changes to This Policy
lines: This policy may be updated occasionally. Users will be notified of significant changes via the website or Discord bot announcement. Continued use of the service after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

sections.title: 12. Contact
lines: For any questions or requests regarding your personal data: privacy@3ds-presence.top

sections.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
lines: By accessing the website, creating an account, or using the 3DS Presence service, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree with these terms, you must not use the service.
Creating an account via Discord also implies acceptance of the Privacy Policy.

sections.title: 2. Service Description
lines: 3DS Presence allows users to display the game they are playing on their Nintendo 3DS directly on their Discord profile (Discord Rich Presence).
The service includes:
list: A website allowing Discord login and account management
A backend server (API) processing activities
A Nintendo 3DS client (boot.firm) installed on the console
An activity generator and, optionally, a Mii avatar generation server

sections.title: 3. Eligibility
lines: To use the service, you must:
list: Be at least 13 years old (minimum age required by Discord to create an account)
If you reside in the European Union, be at least 15 years old or have the authorization of your legal guardian (in accordance with the GDPR)
Have a valid Discord account
Own a Nintendo 3DS with a custom firmware (CFW) installed, as well as a way to transfer files to the console's SD card
sections.warning: ⚠️ Warning — Custom Firmware: Installing a custom firmware (CFW) on your Nintendo 3DS may violate Nintendo's terms of service and void your warranty. You are solely responsible for installing the CFW and for any consequences arising from it. 3DS Presence is not affiliated with Nintendo and cannot be held responsible for any damage resulting from the use of a CFW.

sections.title: 4. User Account
lines: 4.1 Account Creation — The account is created exclusively through Discord authentication (OAuth2). By creating an account, you certify that the information provided is accurate, that you are the legitimate owner of the Discord account used, and that you are not impersonating a third party.
4.2 Single Account — Only one account per user and per Discord ID is allowed. Creating multiple accounts to circumvent a suspension or limitation is prohibited.
4.3 Account Security — You are responsible for the confidentiality of your identifier (UUID) and your AES key. Never share them. In case of compromise, you can reset your AES key from the dashboard.

sections.title: 5. Acceptable Use
lines: You agree to use the service only for its intended purpose: displaying your 3DS gaming activity on your Discord profile.
It is strictly forbidden to:
list: Abuse the service: sending excessive or automated requests to saturate the server or circumvent rate limiting
Impersonate others: using a third party's Discord ID or attempting to pose as another user
Bypass security measures: attempting to access other users' accounts, decrypt others' data, or bypass the anti-bot protection (Cloudflare Turnstile)
Use the service for malicious purposes: harassment, distribution of illegal content, or any activity contrary to applicable laws

Modify the client's behavior towards the API: using a client whose behavior towards the official API has been modified (notably the request frequency, the parameters sent, or the communication protocol) is prohibited, unless this client is used with your own private server. This prohibition does not cover officially supported client features, which allow the user to modify the request through their parameters file and extended RPC from the official repository (https://github.com/3ds-presence/RPC-AddOns), these elements are read and interpreted by the official code without modification of the client

sections.title: 6. Intellectual Property
lines: 6.1 Source Code — The project's source code is published under the GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 (AGPL-3.0). You may view, copy, modify, and redistribute it in accordance with the terms of this license. Any modified instance made publicly available over a network must provide access to its source code (Section 13 of AGPL-3.0).
6.2 Third-Party Trademarks and Rights — 3DS Presence is an independent project. It is neither affiliated with, nor approved by, nor sponsored by Nintendo or Discord Inc.
list: Discord is a trademark of Discord Inc.
Nintendo 3DS is a trademark of Nintendo.
Game names and their icons belong to their respective publishers.

sections.title: 7. Service Availability
lines: The service is provided "as is", without any warranty of availability, reliability, or absence of errors (in accordance with Section 15 of AGPL-3.0).
Temporary interruptions may occur (maintenance, updates, technical incidents).
The project may be interrupted or discontinued at any time, without prior notice.

sections.title: 8. Limitation of Liability
lines: To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law:
list: The 3DS Presence project, its author, and its contributors cannot be held liable for direct or indirect damages resulting from the use or inability to use the service (in accordance with Section 16 of AGPL-3.0)
You are solely responsible for your use of the service and your console
The project cannot be held responsible for a suspension of your Discord account by Discord Inc., for any reason
The project cannot be held responsible for the consequences of installing a custom firmware on your console

sections.title: 9. Suspension and Termination
lines: 9.1 By the User — You can delete your account at any time from the dashboard. Deletion is immediate and permanent.

9.2 By the Service — The project reserves the right to suspend or delete any account in the event of a violation of these terms, and to limit access to the service in case of abuse (notably through rate limiting and anti-bot protection).
9.3 Inactivity — Accounts inactive (no connection to the service) for 3 years are automatically deleted from the database.

sections.title: 10. Personal Data
lines: The processing of your personal data is governed by the Privacy Policy. By using the service, you acknowledge that you have read this policy, in particular regarding:
list: The data collected (Discord ID, UUID, AES key, OAuth2 tokens, game information, Mii data, IP address)
The legal basis (explicit consent)
Your GDPR rights (access, rectification, erasure, portability, objection, withdrawal of consent)
Data retention periods

sections.title: 11. Changes to These Terms
lines: These Terms of Service may be updated from time to time. In the event of a significant change, users will be informed via the website or an announcement. Continued use of the service after the changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

sections.title: 12. Governing Law and Jurisdiction
lines: These terms are governed by French law. In the event of a dispute, and failing amicable resolution, the French courts shall have exclusive jurisdiction, subject to any mandatory provisions applicable in the user's country of residence.

sections.title: 13. Contact
lines: For any questions regarding these Terms of Service, the service, or your personal data: privacy@3ds-presence.top

items.question: What is 3DS Presence?
items.answer: 3DS Presence is an open source service that lets you show the game you are playing on your Nintendo 3DS directly on your Discord profile, through Discord Rich Presence.

items.question: Is 3DS Presence free?
items.answer: Yes. 3DS Presence is completely free and open source, released under the GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 (AGPL-3.0). You can view the source code on GitHub.

items.question: Is 3DS Presence affiliated with Nintendo or Discord?
items.answer: No. 3DS Presence is an independent project. It is neither affiliated, nor approved, nor sponsored by Nintendo or Discord. Game names and trademarks belong to their respective owners.

items.question: What is the difference between 3DS Presence and Presence3DS?
items.answer: 3DS Presence is the name of the project and the website, while Presence3DS is the Luma3DS fork used in this project to connect the 3DS to the 3DS Presence server.

items.question: What are the Terms of Use of 3DS Presence?
items.answer: You can view the Terms of Use at: https://3ds-presence.top/terms.

items.question: What do I need to use 3DS Presence?
items.answer: You need a Nintendo 3DS with boot9strap installed. If you have LumaCFW (Luma3DS), then you have boot9strap. You will also need a Discord account and a way to transfer files to your console's SD card. If you have not installed boot9strap yet, follow a guide (recommended: 3ds.hacks.guide).

items.question: How do I install 3DS Presence on my 3DS?
items.answer: You will need the latest Presence3DS boot.firm available on the website, as well as an account on 3DS Presence. For more information, follow the guide shown on the page once you are connected.

items.question: How do I create an account?
items.answer: Account creation only happens through Discord authentication (OAuth2). Click the "Login with Discord" button on the home page, accept the Privacy Policy and the Terms of Use, and your account will be created automatically.

items.question: How do I download my configuration file?
items.answer: After connecting with Discord, your UUID and AES key are shown on the page. Click the "Download configuration" button to get the configuration file to place in the presence3ds/ folder on your SD card.

items.question: How do I delete my account?
items.answer: Connect with Discord, then click "Delete my account" in your account settings. Deletion is immediate and permanent. All your data will be erased from the database.

items.question: My Discord status is not updating. What should I do?
items.answer: Open the Rosalina menu, then the "Discord RPC..." entry, and check that you are connected to the 3DS Presence server. If you are not connected, connect. If the 3DS refuses to connect, open the "View Log" menu for more information. If you are connected but the status does not show up, ask for help on the Discord server available on the home page.

items.question: The Rosalina menu will not open. What should I do?
items.answer: Make sure Presence3DS is properly installed and up to date. The Rosalina menu opens by default with L + DPAD-Down + Select, but you can change the key combination to access it. If you changed the keys, you must use your custom combination.

items.question: What data is collected and how is it used?
items.answer: You can find out how your data is collected and used at: https://3ds-presence.top/privacy.

items.question: What could happen and what should I do if my AES key is compromised?
items.answer: If someone has your AES key and your UUID, they can only update your Discord RPC remotely. If it is compromised, you can reset your AES key from your account dashboard. Click "Reset AES key" in the settings; a new key will be generated and your old key will become invalid. You will also need to update the configuration file on your 3DS.

items.question: How does security work?
items.answer: The website and the API routes not meant for the 3DS are only accessible over HTTPS. To keep the connection between the 3DS and the server as lightweight as possible, HTTPS is not used because it is too complex. The security is instead provided by AES encryption and a session nonce. As a result, even if someone intercepts the connection between the 3DS and the server, they cannot modify the request without the server noticing it. The nonce is initialized randomly and is incremented at each exchange, which prevents replay attacks.

items.question: Why does 3DS Presence ask to access my Discord friends list when signing in?
items.answer: 3DS Presence does not use your Discord friends list. 3DS Presence only uses the Discord scope "sdk.social_layer_presence", which is required to update your Discord status. Unfortunately, this scope grants many unnecessary permissions, including access to the friends list. 3DS Presence never accesses this information.

installation.title: Installation
installation.prerequisitesText: To use 3DS Presence on your Nintendo 3DS, you need a custom firmware (CFW) installed. Follow a guide like 3ds.hacks.guide if you haven't done this yet. You will also need a way to transfer files to your SD card.
installation.procedureText: Prepare the SD card and configure Presence3DS
stepsList: Download the boot.firm file from the link below.
Copy the boot.firm file to the root of your SD card.
Download the configuration file from the link above.
Copy the configuration file to the presence3ds/ folder on your SD card.
Reinsert the SD card into your 3DS and start it or restart it.
Open the Rosalina menu (by default: L + DPAD-Down + Select).
In the Rosalina menu, select "Discord RPC...".
Configure your preferences (including auto-start) in "User Preferences".
Start the RPC via "Start Discord RPC".
Your Discord status will now update automatically while you play!
